name: Ensure Tables are Setup
purpose: Makes sure the SELECTOR and CONNECTOR tables each hold exactly one record: if the count is not 1 it deletes every record and creates a new one.
writes:
delete: SELECTOR (Delete All Records step 9, all records after Show All Records, only when the count is not 1)
SELECTOR: new record (New Record/Request step 11)
delete: CONNECTOR (Delete All Records step 23, all records after Show All Records, only when the count is not 1)
CONNECTOR: new record (New Record/Request step 25)
open_question: Generator tooling; confirm whether the Generator is part of the migrated product. These two tables hold global session state for the Generator.

name: Refresh xJoins
purpose: Refreshes the cross-join relationships used by the Generator: toggles the z_xJoin field of SELECTOR and CONNECTOR (clear, then 1), then does the same on the table of the current layout by name.
writes:
SELECTOR::z_xJoin#1 (steps 1, 2, global)
CONNECTOR::z_xJoin#1 (steps 3, 4, global)
by name: Get(LayoutTableName) & "::z_xJoin" (Set Field By Name steps 9, 10; step 10 shows a value with no target field)
open_question: Generator tooling; confirm whether the Generator is part of the migrated product. Step 10 is a Set Field By Name with value 1 and no visible target; confirm what it sets.
